rule_condition: True damage ignores mitigation. With no shield, damage is applied to health up to the available 145 health; health is floored at zero and excess damage is not applied. No control effect is applied.
battle_description: Sera has 145 of 1,100 health and no shield before the event. Dax strikes with Rift Pulse, a skill that deals 220 true damage. True damage ignores mitigation. Health cannot fall below zero, excess damage is not applied, and the skill applies no control effect.
transition_summary: Rift Pulse deals 220 true damage. With no shield, 145 damage reduces Sera's health to zero; the remaining 75 damage is not applied. Sera is defeated, with no control effect.
